changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: An account that is being deleted only moves on to deleted, and a deleted account keeps its status, including when a writer uses SQL. An AFTER trigger only validates, so it adds no row lock: a BEFORE row trigger would make each update that names the unique passkey handle lock the row FOR UPDATE and block foreign-key inserts until commit.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER account_transition ON account; DROP FUNCTION guard_account();
